title: Parity sign
statement: For a subset $S\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}$ and a point $x\in\{-1,1\}^n$, define the parity sign on $S$ at $x$ to be the product of the coordinates $x_i$ for $i\in S$, regarded as a unit in the integers.
hypotheses_covered: $x$ is a point of the Boolean cube
